segment: Dental software & dental AI (Gantrell's competitive set)
source: akta.pro REST: news (SD01 launches, RC01 approvals, CM01 equity), company enrichment (funding_detail, product_offering, strategic_signal, financial_estimate, company_assessment), headcount-trends

method.tiers: 1 = new product line/market or regulatory clearance that unlocks one; 2 = major capability or distribution-expanding integration; 3 = minor feature/update (standard PMM launch tiering)
method.velocity: weighted launch points per 90 days (T1=3, T2=2, T3=1)
method.grounding: a classification is kept only if its evidence quote appears verbatim in the Akta title/summary
method.caveats: Akta news lookback is 12 months on our plan; funding dates are month-level and trimmed to 3 rounds; pre/post-round velocity only where a round falls inside the window.

top_tier1_launches.title: Pearl Launches Second Opinion 3D, Bringing FDA-Cleared CBCT Imaging AI to General Dentists for the First Time
top_tier1_launches.summary: Pearl launched Second Opinion 3D, making its FDA-cleared CBCT imaging AI available to general dentists in the US and Canada. The product adds embedded specialist radiology-report requests and automatic conversion of CBCT findings into insurance claim-ready documentation. AI-powered pathology detection is available in Canada and pending approval in additional markets.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: Pearl launched Second Opinion 3D, making its FDA-cleared CBCT imaging AI available to general dentists in the US and Canada.
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: A new 3D product that opens the general dentist CBCT market, backed by Pearl's unique 2D and 3D FDA clearance.

top_tier1_launches.title: Planet DDS Declares the Practice Management Era Over and Launches DentalOS®, the Dental Enterprise Platform for DSOs
top_tier1_launches.summary: Planet DDS launched DentalOS®, a new dental enterprise software platform designed to replace traditional practice management systems for DSOs and multi-location dental groups. The platform connects Denticon and Cloud 9 practice management systems on a single data layer, incorporating AI-powered enterprise tools including confirmation agents, clinical voice documentation, and revenue cycle management capabilities. The company, which already serves more than half of the largest 60 DSOs in North America across 14,500 practices, positions this launch as addressing the industry-wide shift from acquisition-driven growth to operational consolidation requiring enterprise-grade infrastructure.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: Planet DDS launched DentalOS®, a new dental enterprise software platform designed to replace traditional practice management systems for DSOs and multi-location dental groups.
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: Unifies Denticon and Cloud 9 on a single data layer with AI tools, repositioning from PMS to enterprise platform and deepening switching costs for DSOs.
top_tier1_launches.context_quote: Unifying practice management, imaging, payments, patient engagement, financing (CareCredit), and AI agents on one platform

top_tier1_launches.title: Pearl Expands Dental AI Capabilities with FDA Clearance for Panoramic X-Rays
top_tier1_launches.summary: Pearl, a dental AI company, announced FDA 510(k) clearance for its Second Opinion platform to detect dental pathologies on panoramic radiographs, expanding its radiologic AI technology to this widely used extraoral imaging modality. The clearance is supported by clinical validation studies demonstrating improved detection of caries, periapical radiolucencies, and impacted third molars across diverse patient subgroups. Pearl positions this as a major advancement making panoramic x-ray interpretation more reliable, with the technology now available to U.S. and international users.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: announced FDA 510(k) clearance for its Second Opinion platform to detect dental pathologies on panoramic radiographs
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: A new imaging modality clearance that widens Pearl's 2D and 3D FDA lead, which competitors would need years to replicate.

top_tier1_launches.title: Overjet Announces New FDA Clearance for CBCT 3D Imaging
top_tier1_launches.summary: Overjet, a dental AI company based in San Mateo, California, has received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its CBCT Assist product, the company's 10th FDA clearance to date. The new AI-powered tool enables dental professionals to review and interpret 3D cone beam computed tomography images by automatically identifying, labeling, segmenting, and quantifying anatomical structures. Overjet is offering early access to CBCT Assist for clinics based in the United States.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: has received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its CBCT Assist product, the company's 10th FDA clearance to date
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: Clearance extends Overjet from 2D to 3D CBCT imaging, opening implant and surgical planning, and adds to its regulatory moat.
top_tier1_launches.context_quote: CBCT Assist received FDA 510(k) clearance in December 2025 — Overjet's 10th FDA clearance

top_tier1_launches.title: VideaHealth Launches ClaimsAI to Eliminate Dental RCM Waste and Claim Denials
top_tier1_launches.summary: VideaHealth launched ClaimsAI, an AI-driven revenue cycle management solution designed to help dental organizations reduce claim denials and recover lost revenue. The platform automates the assembly of clinical attachments and narratives, addressing an estimated $15 billion in annual losses across the U.S. dental industry. Early user results indicate up to 90% faster claim submissions and significant reduction in accounts receivable backlogs.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: VideaHealth launched ClaimsAI, an AI-driven revenue cycle management solution
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: Extends Videa from clinical AI into the roughly $15B dental RCM market, opening a new product line and wallet share.
top_tier1_launches.context_quote: addressing roughly $15B in dental RCM waste per company commentary

top_tier1_launches.title: VideaHealth Launches Voice Notes, the First Ambient AI Scribe Purpose-Built for Dentistry
top_tier1_launches.summary: VideaHealth, a Boston-based dental AI platform, announced the launch of Voice Notes, the first AI-powered ambient scribe designed specifically for dentistry that converts chairside conversations into clinical notes without disrupting workflow. The solution delivers measurable outcomes including over 10 hours of time saved per provider weekly, up to $117,000 in additional annual revenue per dentist, and 95% complete clinical notes on first pass. Voice Notes is HIPAA-compliant, marks VideaHealth's entry into ambient AI, and is available immediately as a standalone solution or integrated with VideaAI Clinical Assist.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: the first AI-powered ambient scribe designed specifically for dentistry
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: Marks Videa's entry into ambient AI as a new product line beyond X-ray diagnostics, extending the platform's multi-product account strategy.
top_tier1_launches.context_quote: Voice Notes, Voice Perio, Daily Dashboard, Insights, Clean Claims, AutoVerify, ClaimsAI, and the new Ambient Intelligence category
